vault.unavailable: The vault could not be read, so it is not known whether one exists on this device.

create.title: Create the vault
create.description: The vault password protects every credential saved on this device. It is not stored anywhere and cannot be recovered: if it is lost, the saved sessions and keys are lost with it.
create.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

unlock.title: Unlock the vault
unlock.description: Enter the master password to unlock the session and credential store.

setAside.moved: Kept as {name}. Rename it back to restore it.

reset.link: Forgot the password? Archive and reset
reset.title: Archive the current vault?
reset.message: The vault file on this device is renamed and kept — nothing is deleted — and a new vault is created in its place.

history.title: Archived vaults
history.description: Archived vaults were found on this device. One can be made the live vault and unlocked again, or its credentials can be merged into the current vault once that one is open.
history.empty: No archived vaults on this device yet. A vault that cannot be opened is kept here once it has been moved aside.
history.importNeedsUnlock: Unlock the master vault before merging an import into it.
history.imported: {sessions} sessions, {groups} groups and {secrets} credentials were added.
history.importedMissingKeys: {count} of them name a key this device does not hold.
history.importedDroppedHops: {count} jumped through a session the archive did not carry.
history.activateNeedsLock: Lock the vault you are in before switching to another one.
history.activateMessage: The current vault is renamed and kept as an archive, and the selected file takes its place as the live vault — no data is lost. Unlocking afterwards needs the password that archive was written with.
history.activated: {name} is the live vault now. Unlock it with its own password.
